notes: Final score = 0 + 18 + 4 + 3 = 25/100. Keppel Education Asset Funds (KEAF II FUM about $2.6 billion) invest in education-related real estate such as campuses and student accommodation. That is property investment, not education delivery, so it is not scored as an education business. Senior living communities (Sindora Living) are care and real estate services, not scored. Multilingual whistle-blower hotlines and multilingual compliance e-learning are compliance mechanisms (a trap), not customer access. The board target of about 30% female directors by 2030 is planned and not scored. E3 is investor-relations adjacent; the Community level 3 rests mainly on E1 and E2. The $4.2 million figure combines social investment with 'industry advancement', so the purely philanthropic share is unclear. The whistle-blower channels received two workplace discrimination allegations in 2025 with 'no material findings identified', so no substantiated case is reported and no red flag is listed. The Keppel Sakra Cogen Plant is a natural gas and hydrogen-compatible plant, not coal.
